app_name: NSEC Academia Network (Netaji Subhas Engineering College)
context: Hybrid Academic Social Platform (LinkedIn meets Reddit & Facebook for NSEC)

components.name: AuthModal
components.purpose: Email/password registration & login with role selection (Student, Teacher, Founder) + Google login & access issue help

components.name: Feed
components.purpose: Academic social feed with post creation, compressed picture upload (max 800px width, JPEG 60%), likes, comments, and relationship status on profiles

components.name: DiscussionRooms
components.purpose: Reddit-style subreddits for academic departments, clubs, hostel life, and placement talks

components.name: TeacherUpdates
components.purpose: Dedicated feed where teachers upload daily teaching logs, lecture notes, and assignment reminders

components.name: FounderInfoSection
components.purpose: Editable placeholders for Oildrila and Arjun Jha along with NSEC mission and access issue resolution hotline

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a robust full-stack React frontend and FastAPI backend for NSEC Academia Network. Ensure image compression (max 800px width, 60% JPEG quality on client/server), role-based access (Student, Teacher, Founder), relationship status display, discussion rooms, and editable founder placeholders for Oildrila and Arjun Jha. Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.
